# 2 Chronicles Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In-year thirty-and-six of-reign-of Asa he-came-up Baasha king-of Israel against Judah and-he-built Ramah to-not give going-out and-coming-in to-Asa king-of Judah.

**2** And-he-brought-out Asa silver and-gold from-treasuries-of house-of YHWH and-house-of the-king and-he-sent to-Ben-hadad king-of Aram the-dwelling in-Damascus saying

**3** a-covenant is-between-me and-between-you and-between my-father and-between your-father behold I-have-sent to-you silver and-gold go break your-covenant with Baasha king-of Israel and-he-will-go-up from-upon-me.

**4** And-he-listened Ben-hadad to-the-king Asa and-he-sent commanders-of the-armies that were-for-him against cities-of Israel and-they-struck Ijon and-Dan and-Abel-maim and-all store-cities-of Naphtali.

**5** And-it-was as-heard Baasha and-he-stopped from-building Ramah and-he-ceased his-work.

**6** And-Asa the-king he-took all Judah and-they-carried the-stones-of Ramah and-its-timbers that built Baasha and-he-built with-them Geba and-Mizpah.

**7** And-in-the-time that came Hanani the-seer to Asa king-of Judah and-he-said to-him because-you-leaned on king-of Aram and-not you-leaned on YHWH your-God therefore escaped army-of king-of Aram from-your-hand.

**8** Were-not the-Cushites and-the-Lubim an-army for-abundance with-chariots and-horsemen for-very-many and-when-you-leaned on YHWH He-gave-them in-your-hand.

**9** For YHWH His-eyes range-about in-all the-earth to-strengthen-Himself with those-whose heart is-complete toward-Him you-have-acted-foolishly in-this for from-now there-is for-you wars.

**10** And-he-was-angry Asa at the-seer and-he-put-him in-house-of the-stocks for in-a-rage with-him over this and-he-oppressed Asa from the-people in-the-time that.

**11** And-behold acts-of Asa the-first and-the-last behold-them written on book-of the-kings of-Judah and-Israel.

**12** And-he-was-diseased Asa in-year thirty-and-nine of-his-reign in-his-feet until-upward was his-disease and-also in-his-disease not he-sought YHWH but the-healers.

**13** And-he-lay-down Asa with his-fathers and-he-died in-year forty-and-one of-his-reign.

**14** And-they-buried-him in-his-tombs that he-dug for-himself in-city-of David and-they-laid-him in-the-bed that he-filled with-spices and-kinds mixed in-ointment-of work and-they-burned for-him a-burning great very.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **16:7**: because-you-leaned on king-of Aram and-not you-leaned on YHWH — The verb sha'an (lean/rely) appears again. Asa, who once relied on God against a million Cushites, now relies on a pagan king against a fellow Israelite. The contrast is devastating.

- **16:9**: His-eyes range-about in-all the-earth — One of the most quoted verses in Chronicles. God actively searches for faithful hearts to empower. The image is of cosmic surveillance motivated by grace.

- **16:12**: not he-sought YHWH but the-healers — The Chronicler's critique is not of medicine but of misplaced trust. Asa's failure is theological, not medical.


— EMET
